header.title: BlockUi
header.description: Layer that covers the whole window and blocks the interface while something loads or saves. By default it's white and translucent, with a large spinner in the center, so the page stays visible but can't be used. While active it blocks clicks, the keyboard and scrolling. Use it for short operations that affect the whole screen; if only one part is loading, a `Spinner` or a skeleton in that area works better.

demo.title: Workspace overview
demo.body: The layer sits on top of this content. Translucent white keeps the page visible while blocking interaction.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Adjust the props and press the button to see the block. The layer covers the whole window, not just the demo, and goes away on its own after the chosen duration.

base.title: Basic usage
base.description: `blocking` turns the layer on and off. While it's `true`, the layer renders in a portal on `document.body` and the rest of the page becomes inert. Pass it a translated `aria-label`: it says "Loading" by default.

overlay.title: Custom background
overlay.description: `overlay` accepts any `background` value: a color, a token or a gradient. Transparency isn't written in the color but in `opacity`, so you can use tokens without building alpha colors.

texts.title: Invoice details
texts.body: Loading keeps the current view in place, so you can see what's being refreshed.

content.title: Custom content
content.description: With `children` you replace the spinner with anything: a `Spinner` with text, a card or a short message. The content stays centered and isn't affected by `opacity`.

texts.title: Export report
texts.body: Visible text helps explain why the screen is blocked and how long it may take.
texts.label: Preparing export

opacity.title: Opacity
opacity.description: `opacity` goes from 1 (almost clear) to 100 (opaque) and defaults to 56. Out-of-range values are clamped. At low values the content behind stays readable.

texts.title: Opacity samples
texts.body: Each button blocks the screen with a different opacity.
texts.label: Opacity

async.title: While saving
async.description: The most common case: tie `blocking` to the state of a request. Turn it on before starting and off in `finally`, so the screen is released even if the request fails.

texts.title: Account preferences
texts.body: Saving blocks the screen until the server responds, so the form isn't submitted twice.

header.title: BlockUi API
header.description: API reference for the BlockUi React component: props, CSS classes, CSS variables, tokens and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demos page.

import.title: Import
import.description: You can import it from the main entry or from its subpath.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts the HTML attributes of a <div> (HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>) and passes them to the layer. style is merged with the variables the component writes. classNames adds classes to each part: root, content and spinner.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.status: The layer has role="status" and aria-live="polite", so screen readers announce the loading without interrupting. If you pass another role, it doesn't add aria-live.
a11y.busy: Adds aria-busy="true" to the layer and to <body> while active.
a11y.inert: Marks the other children of <body> as inert: they can't be focused or clicked. When it turns off it restores their previous value.
a11y.scroll: Blocks page scrolling with overflow: hidden on <body> and restores it when done.
a11y.spinner: The default spinner is decorative (aria-hidden); the accessible name is the layer's aria-label.
a11y.labels: aria-label is in English by default ("Loading"). Pass it translated, or use aria-labelledby if the text is already visible in the layer.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Classes you can use to override styles.

rules.root: Fixed layer that covers the window. Receives `className` and `classNames.root`. Defines the BlockUi variables.
rules.overlay: Pseudo-element with the background. Uses `--gem-block-ui-overlay` and `--gem-block-ui-opacity`.
rules.content: Centered container for `children` or the spinner. Receives `classNames.content`.
rules.spinner: Default spinner, only when there are no `children`. Receives `classNames.spinner`.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Defined on `.gem-block-ui`. `--gem-block-ui-opacity` is always written inline from the `opacity` prop, and `--gem-block-ui-overlay` only when you pass `overlay`; to change them from a class, don't pass those props. `--gem-block-ui-spinner-size` can be changed freely.

items.--gem-block-ui-spinner-size: Default spinner size. Drops to `--gem-icon-4xl` on screens under 640px.

items.--gem-palette-neutral-0: Default value of `--gem-block-ui-overlay` (white, also in the dark theme).
items.--gem-z-max: Stacking layer, above modals and menus.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

props.title: Props
props.description: It also accepts the HTML attributes of a `<div>`.

items.blocking: Shows the layer and blocks the page. With `false` it renders nothing.
items.overlay: Layer background: color, token or gradient.
items.opacity: Background opacity, from `1` to `100`. Doesn't affect the centered content.
items.children: Centered content. If omitted, a large spinner is shown.
items.aria-label: Accessible name of the layer. Ignored if you pass `aria-labelledby`.
items.role: Layer role. With any value other than the default, it doesn't add `aria-live`.
items.style: Inline styles. Merged with the variables the component writes.
